name: File Stream Bot
description: An ultra-fast and efficient Telegram file streaming and direct download bot powered by Hydrogram and Quart.

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram User ID of the Bot Owner

TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID.description: Telegram Storage Channel ID (must start with -100...)

BASE_URL.description: Your App URL (e.g. https://your-app-name.herokuapp.com or custom domain). Leave blank to auto-detect.

ALLOWED_USER_IDS.description: Space-separated Telegram User IDs allowed to use the bot. Leave empty to allow all users.

MULTI_BOT_TOKENS.description: Optional space or comma-separated secondary bot tokens for multi-worker parallel streaming speedup.

CACHE_SIZE_MB.description: In-memory LRU chunk cache size in MB (e.g. 64 or 128 for 0ms instant playback start).

PREFETCH_CHUNKS.description: Number of 1MB chunks to prefetch concurrently ahead during streaming.
